status: post-analysis source-quality audit; previously observed model results are acknowledged
authorization: This record is the analysis plan for a reconstruction attempt. It is not author approval and not a preregistration.

sources.rule: Nilsson et al. 2018, Figure 1B: endpoint concentration below 10% of fresh concentration for at least one measured metabolite
sources.input: Frozen corrected original Jain 2012 Database S1.xls, Concentrations sheet
sources.growth_data: Source describes 4 or 5 days; no per-culture time-series cell counts have been recovered. No growth correction will be invented.

planned_reconstructions.name: all_reported_assays
planned_reconstructions.assays: All 140 source rows; each evaluated only if fresh mean is positive and finite, and endpoint finite/nonnegative
planned_reconstructions.reason: Literal any-metabolite wording. Uncalibrated rows are retained only as relative signal screening, not absolute physical concentration.

planned_reconstructions.name: calibrated_assays
planned_reconstructions.assays: Source calibrated flag equals 1, same arithmetic
planned_reconstructions.reason: Separately declared check limited to calibrated measurements; do not select one variant based on favorable results.

fresh_estimate: Arithmetic mean of the ten named Baseline1-Baseline5 columns after published instrument-drift correction. This is a reconstruction assumption until exact 2018 supplement/code is obtained. No nearest-batch assignment invented.
flag_rule: strict endpoint < 0.10 * fresh_mean; any flag marks that culture screen-positive; missing/nonpositive fresh rows are unresolved individually
paired_profile_rule: Both original replicate cultures must have no observed screen-positive analyte before a profile is called screen-negative in this reconstruction. This is not a certificate of physiological validity.
allocation: Use frozen contexts.tsv mapping; do not relabel development profiles; unmatched source lines retained as excluded/unmatched
coverage: Report all 120 source cultures, all 60 source lines, and 58 matched model profiles separately; compare independently with 36 nondepleted/84 depleted cultures reported by Nilsson2018 and with the deposited Human1 11-line list; exact agreement is not assumed
outcome_use: No predictions or performance statistics will be loaded. No quality-filtered accuracy score calculated in this phase. Only source measurements and allocation used.
nonclaims: No correction of historical CORE rates
No claim that screen-negative cultures have valid growth curves
No retrospective choice of thresholds or assay list to reproduce desired counts
